script: Good sleep is one of the best things you can do for your health. Keep your bedroom dark, cool and quiet. Put your phone away an hour before bed and read a book instead. Try to go to bed and wake up at the same time every day. Avoid coffee in the afternoon and heavy meals late at night. A short walk in the morning sunlight helps your body clock too. After a week of good habits you will wake up feeling fresh and ready for the day.
